\noindent\textit{Instructions: Answer any \textbf{five} questions. All questions carry equal marks. Symbols have their usual meanings.}
\bigskip

\medskip\noindent\textbf{Question 1.}
\begin{parts}
  \item With the help of examples, explain the following types of constants in C: numeric, character, real, and string constants. \pts{7}
  \item Write the output of the following C expressions, given \texttt{int a=2, b=5, c=3}:
  \begin{parts}
    \item \texttt{m = 2 - a + 5 * 2 / 8 \% 3}
    \item \texttt{x = a * b / a * b - c}
    \item \texttt{w = (a * (c + b)) * (b + 5 - 2)}
    \item \texttt{x = b - b / 2 + c}
  \end{parts}\pts{7}
\end{parts}

\medskip\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}

\medskip\noindent\textbf{Question 2.}
\begin{parts}
  \item With the help of a program, explain the use of the increment (\texttt{++}), decrement (\texttt{--}), and conditional (\texttt{?:}) operators in C. \pts{7}
  \item Describe any two input and output functions used in C with examples. \pts{7}
\end{parts}

\medskip\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}

\medskip\noindent\textbf{Question 3.}
\begin{parts}
  \item Describe the \texttt{if-else} statement in C. Write a C program to find the maximum of $n$ given numbers. \pts{7}
  \item With the help of a program, explain the use of the \texttt{switch} statement in C. \pts{7}
\end{parts}

\medskip\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}

\medskip\noindent\textbf{Question 4.}
\begin{parts}
  \item With the help of a program, explain the use of \texttt{break}, \texttt{continue}, and \texttt{goto} statements in C. \pts{7}
  \item Define one-, two-, and multi-dimensional arrays in C. Write a C program to add two matrices. \pts{7}
\end{parts}

\medskip\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}

\medskip\noindent\textbf{Question 5.}
\begin{parts}
  \item With the help of examples, explain the use of automatic, external, and static variables in C. \pts{7}
  \item With the help of a user-defined function, write a C program to find the variance of $n$ given numbers. \pts{7}
\end{parts}

\medskip\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}

\medskip\noindent\textbf{Question 6.}
\begin{parts}
  \item With the help of a program, explain the difference between \textit{call by value} and \textit{call by reference} in C. \pts{7}
  \item Explain the use of pointers in C. Also explain the use of pointers in the implementation of arrays with a suitable example. \pts{7}
\end{parts}

\medskip\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}

\medskip\noindent\textbf{Question 7.}
\begin{parts}
  \item Define structure in C. Write a C program demonstrating the use of an array of structures. \pts{7}
  \item Describe the similarities and differences between structures and unions in C. Write a program demonstrating the use of a union. \pts{7}
\end{parts}

\medskip\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}

\medskip\noindent\textbf{Question 8.} Write short notes on any \textbf{two} of the following:\pts{14}
\begin{parts}
  \item History of the C programming language
  \item Recursion in functions
  \item Use of files in C
  \item Scope and lifetime of variables
\end{parts}
